title: American Airlines 6780
summary: On 22 January 1952, American Airlines Flight 6780, a Convair 240, was on final approach to Newark Airport using the instrument landing system when it crashed into a house in Elizabeth, New Jersey, approximately 3.4 miles southwest of Newark. The aircraft had gone 2,100 feet off course to the right. All 23 occupants on board plus 7 people on the ground were killed. The cause of the crash was never determined.
